\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-99},
  title = {Prometheus and two exporters in every stack, Grafana through SSH, alerts to Discord},
  date = {2026-11-04},
  milestone = {M6: Monitoring},
  topic = {Monitoring, Containerization},
  participants = {Lukas Häußler (decided), AI agents (architecture proposal, implementation)},
  decision = {Prometheus scrapes the API, cAdvisor (per container) and node-exporter (the host) every 15 s inside the Compose network and keeps at most 2 GB or 60 days.
None publishes a port, and all always run, without a Compose profile.
Grafana answers on the VM's 127.0.0.1 through an SSH tunnel; tested Prometheus rules alert via Alertmanager to Discord, saying what to do.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item node-exporter only: no per-container memory or restarts.
\item cAdvisor only: a weak view of the host's disk (NFR-04's 4 GB floor).
\item A Compose profile: CI, laptops, and the VM would run different stacks.
\item Grafana behind nginx: login and query API public.
\item Grafana alerting: untestable, silent when Grafana is down; email: SMTP credentials.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} NFR-04 limits each container and the disk, and each exporter covers one of them.
The VM's ports 8080 to 8089 are public, so nothing new is published.
The three used 79 MiB of their 640 MiB of limits on a laptop.
cAdvisor runs as root with the Docker socket, the tested exception to the shared hardening.},
  ai = {Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI proposed the exporters, the retention, and the closed ports; Lukas took the package unchanged.
AI built it, with tests that every target is up, the retention is set, and only nginx publishes a port.
AI accepted the exporters' fixable Go findings in \texttt{.\allowbreak{}trivyignore} until 2026-12-04, each with a reason.
AI found SSH from eduroam timing out (2026-11-04): the tunnel needs UPClink on campus too.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-11-04.
